newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht steady late, interbank rate falls.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht steady late, interbank rate falls.

text.p: The Thai baht was steady against the dollar in late trade on Tuesday on with heavy selling of the dollar being seen in the afternoon, dealers said.
The baht was under some selling pressure in the morning on the concerns about the health of most local finance companies, dealers said.
"The baht was traded as low as three satangs below the central bank's fixing. But strong selling of the dollar in the afternoon help the baht to recover," said one broker at a European bank.
The baht was quoted at 25.925/25.935 per dollar late compared with 25.927/25.932 in late morning trade, dealers aid.
The Bank of Thailand set the baht/dollar mid-rate at 25.92 baht to the dollar against 25.87 on Monday.
The dealer said baht/dollar trade was not panicked as the market already discounted the news of finance companies' liquidity problem.
The overnight interbank rate dropped to 7.50-8.00 percent near close from 8.50-9.00 percent in the morning on higher liquidity, dealers said.
